design_concept: Editorial Architectural Dark Luxury Agency Landing Page

scale_rules.hero_headline: text-[12vw] sm:text-[14vw] md:text-[16vw] lg:text-[18vw] leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter uppercase font-black
scale_rules.section_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase
scale_rules.subtitle: text-lg sm:text-xl text-[#8A8780] font-light tracking-wide uppercase
scale_rules.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#C5A059] font-mono

brand_identity.lion_mark: Abstract thin gold mane and crown geometry composed of 0.75px–1.5px gold lines (#C5A059), responsive to scroll and hover state vector animations.
aesthetic_guidelines: Editorial, architectural, and cinematic feel with extreme asymmetrical compositions.
Strict density alternation: contrast high-density editorial blocks with massive negative space (150–200vh height sections).
Cardless visual hierarchy using 1px razor gold/dark borders instead of rounded shadowed cards.
Zero stock photos: replace visual placeholders with architectural raw render photography and abstract editorial portraits.
Zero emojis: use sharp geometric glyphs, Roman numerals, or inline technical specs.

layout_and_grid.grid_columns: 12-column asymmetric editorial grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-12)
layout_and_grid.section_spacing: py-24 md:py-36 lg:py-48 px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-20

sections.name: Line Art Preloader
sections.description: Minimal full-screen intro with abstract gold mane geometry drawing animation and percentage counter (00-100%).

sections.name: Architectural Floating Nav
sections.description: Fixed header with gold abstract lion logo mark, Kazakhstan language indicator (KZ/EN/RU), navigation coordinates, and minimalist contact button.

sections.name: Cinematic Hero
sections.description: Overwhelming 12-18vw grotesk typography 'DIGITAL TERRITORY', abstract lion crown gold geometry, location tag (ALMATY, KZ // 43.2389° N), and scroll velocity trigger.

sections.name: Scroll-Driven Statement + Metrics
sections.description: 150-200vh storytelling block with sticky editorial manifesto text and gold accent counters (+340% Performance, 99.8% Speed Score, 4.8M Kazakh Tenge ROI).

sections.name: Horizontal Portfolio Gallery
sections.description: Horizontal scroll showcase of premium web architecture cases (Astana Luxury Real Estate, Nomad FinTech, Qazaq Spirits, Silk Road Motors).

sections.name: Numbered Services Index
sections.description: Architectural grid (01 - Digital Architecture, 02 - E-Commerce Flagships, 03 - Brand Identity Systems, 04 - High-Load Web Solutions) with hover gold line reveals.

sections.name: Interactive Estimator
sections.description: Custom project cost & timeline calculator with gold sliders, scope toggles, and live price summary in KZT / USD.

sections.name: Mobile + SEO Split View
sections.description: Side-by-side interactive comparison showing raw code efficiency, Mobile Lighthouse 100/100 metrics, and organic search dominant hierarchy.

sections.name: Process Timeline
sections.description: Asymmetrical 4-stage architectural roadmap (Audit & Discovery -> Spatial Wireframing -> Code Crafting -> Deployment & Dominance).

sections.name: Editorial Team
sections.description: High-fashion dark monochrome portraits of agency founders and design architects with hover detail reveals.

sections.name: Philosophy & Manifesto
sections.description: Massive typographic stance against generic digital templates and 'AI slop' websites.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.description: Monumental typography booking trigger 'CLAIM YOUR TERRITORY' with direct consultation form.

sections.name: Architectural Footer
sections.description: 10vw giant brand mark, Kazakh office coordinates, system status (ALL SYSTEMS OPTIMAL), and copyright info.

sections.name: Custom Cursor System
sections.description: Gold ring cursor with subtle inertia trailing and magnetic hover state expander.

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, estimator inputs, toggles, filter buttons, modals, form fields) MUST include unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app (JavaScript .js files) matching all requirements.
Import Google Fonts Syne and Plus Jakarta Sans in index.html.
Enforce deep dark background #080808 / #0B0B0B with warm off-white #F3F0E9 text and warm metallic gold #C5A059 accents.
Do NOT use glassmorphism excess or rounded-xl soft cards. Use sharp or subtle 1px border cards with background elevation #0B0B0B / #121211.
All interactive components must have proper state management and micro-interactions powered by Framer Motion.
